Every row: STATUS | RESULT | EVIDENCE (— TEST COUNT where the row ran a test).

RESULT: nonexistent package/file/asset/resource, closed+invalid FD, cross-package, traversal, host absolute, malformed APK x3, missing lib, invalid DB, missing prefs — all typed honest failures. 28. **reinstall** — STATUS: TESTED. RESULT: clean namespace (no leftover state), fresh app state per AOSP semantics. EVIDENCE:  — TEST COUNT/EVIDENCE: reinstall matrix 8/8

31. **fake-success audit** — STATUS: PASS. RESULT: probe found 11 divergences (host-path exposure, provider authority/attachInfo, obbdir, getIdentifier, NotFound, loadLibrary, MODE_APPEND trunc, AFD declaredLength, raw stream, PFD args, manifest components) — ALL fixed generically before any claim; remaining 3 gaps are loud, recorded, severity-ranked. EVIDENCE:  — TEST COUNT/EVIDENCE: CAPABILITY_GATE.md §2; GAPS.md
32. **final gap inventory** — STATUS: PARTIAL. RESULT: 8 gaps enumerated with API/law→impl→AOSP→evidence→families→severity→next action (G-3 content:// query MEDIUM, G-5 AFD byte-equality MEDIUM, G-6 array String equality LOW-MED, others LOW/document-deviation). EVIDENCE:  — TEST COUNT/EVIDENCE: docs/INSTALL_ENVIRONMENT_GAPS.md
33. **capability percentage** — STATUS: OBSERVED. RESULT: denominator = 60 API-matrix rows: 57 TESTED/PASS, 3 PARTIAL → ~95%; percentage NOT used as a completion claim. EVIDENCE:  — TEST COUNT/EVIDENCE: API_MATRIX.jsonl
34. **final honest status** — STATUS: PARTIAL. RESULT: GATE A OPERATIONAL: install→hide→inspect→trace→provenance complete and machine-readable; 3 open gaps (G-3/G-5/G-6) keep strict PARTIAL — GATE B (render) and GATE C (visual) explicitly NOT claimed. EVIDENCE:  — TEST COUNT/EVIDENCE: this ledger

Final engineering question (issue text): **YES** for every inspection surface in the matrix above — an agent given an installed package identity can determine what exists, what was attempted, what physical backing was used, what failed, and the first missing capability, without guessing, with the 3 named gaps (G-3/G-5/G-6) the only remaining inspection deltas, each with a next action in docs/INSTALL_ENVIRONMENT_GAPS.md. GATE B/C rendering is explicitly outside this ledger.
